fields.title: A recovered ledger loses at most five minutes of payments
fields.measured-by: A quarterly restore of the ledger database into an isolated environment

sections.Target:
RPO of 5 minutes and RTO of 1 hour for the ledger database behind [svc-payment-ledger].

Five minutes is what the reconciliation can repair. The PSP's settlement file lists every authorisation it took, so a gap shorter than one file can be rebuilt from it. A longer gap needs the PSP's support desk, and no procedure covers that.
sections.How it is measured: A quarterly restore into an isolated environment measures both figures. The recovery time runs from the decision to restore to the ledger serving queries. The recovery point compares the last entry in the restored data with the last entry the source held.
sections.If it is breached: Payments taken inside the lost window are absent from the account finance reconciles. The money moved and the ledger has no entry for it. The repair is the PSP's settlement file, and until that runs the ledger understates what was taken.
